latestVersion.changelog:
Amazon Backend Report Analyzer initial release.

- Automatically analyzes Amazon Seller Central business, inventory, advertising, and financial reports to surface actionable insights.
- Supports paste-in CSV/text report analysis with clear performance summaries and prioritized action items.
- Offers commands for analyzing various report types, comparing time periods, generating weekly digests, and managing workspace archives.
- Frameworks and benchmarks included for business, inventory, advertising, and financial report analysis.
- Outputs include performance summaries, anomaly detection, inventory status, ad performance, financial health, action lists, and next week forecasts.
